subject: Pilot runway adjustment: credit top-up + deferred billing option
messages:
From: Claire O'Neill <claire@brightbytelabs.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — can we extend the pilot one week + surge credits?

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the run this week — my team made good progress. We're seeing a spike in end-to-end tests that will likely blow past our remaining token allocation before the pilot end date (May 26). Two quick asks:

- Can we add a short one-week extension to the timebox (to June 2) to finish a second integration test?
- If an extension isn't possible, would Redwood consider a small top-up of credits specifically for onboarding/surge runs?

We'd prefer not to change the current PO terms (procurement is already queued) so any solution that doesn't require renegotiating the SOW would be ideal. Happy to sign an addendum or accept a limited-use credit voucher.

Claire
Claire O'Neill
Head of Data Platform | BrightByte Labs

Attachment: sample-test-plan.xlsx (attachment referenced, but not included here)

From: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: Claire O'Neill <claire@brightbytelabs.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — can we extend the pilot one week + surge credits?

Hi Claire — appreciate the heads up and glad the tests are productive. Two options we can offer without touching procurement:

1) One-week timebox extension (May 26 -> Jun 2) on the existing SOW, executed via a short addendum. We can approve this immediately; it doesn't change pricing.

2) Credit top-up: provide a 25k-token onboarding credit that is restricted to inference usage (expires in 30 days). We can couple this with a short commitment to a follow-on evaluation if that helps procurement.

If you'd like deferred billing (i.e., Redwood invoices the addendum but billing deferred 30 days), we can do that for customers moving from evaluation to PO, pending finance sign-off.

Which option would your team prefer? Happy to draw up the addendum or the credit voucher.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Fw: Quick ask — can we extend the pilot one week + surge credits?

Laura / Stephanie — quick question. BrightByte (RDW-4872) hit a surge and asks for either a 1-week timebox extension or a small onboarding credit. Procurement prefers no SOW changes. Can finance sign off on a 25k-token restricted credit with 30-day expiry and deferred billing? If deferred billing isn't viable, the addendum route is fine but that will require procurement sign-off and could delay acceptance.

Context: BrightByte is a mid-stage data infra company, high strategic fit. They were green across our evaluation metrics last week. I think a small credit + standard addendum language will close the loop faster.

Thoughts?
— Karthik

From: stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com
To: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fw: Quick ask — can we extend the pilot one week + a credit?

Karthik — finance is OK to sponsor a one-off onboarding credit (25k tokens) as long as:

- It's restricted to inference usage and cannot be converted to committed spend.
- It expires 30 days after issuance.
- We attach a short addendum that records the extension/credit but explicitly states no change to PO terms and no change to billing cadence unless the customer signs the PO.

Deferred billing: Finance will permit 30-day deferred invoicing for the addendum only if Legal signs off that the customer will not require service continuation past the trial without a PO in place. Given procurement's stance, deferred billing introduces accounting complexity; I recommend the credit voucher path to keep this simple.

I'll prepare a one-page addendum and the credit voucher template — Laura, do you want me to route the addendum for signature or should we ask BrightByte to e-sign via DocuSign?

Thanks,
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Finance Manager | Redwood Inference

From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: Claire O'Neill <claire@brightbytelabs.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot addendum & onboarding credit — BrightByte Labs

Claire — thanks for the details and for flagging procurement's preference. Per our internal review we can offer the following that keeps the PO unchanged: 

1) 1-week timebox extension (new end date: 2027-06-02). This will be documented with a 1-page addendum (no change to pricing on the PO).

2) A one-time, restricted onboarding credit: 25,000 tokens usable only for inference during the extension window; credit expires 30 days after issuance.

We will NOT change billing terms on the existing PO; that means any invoice related to the addendum will follow standard invoicing unless you request DocuSign e-sign and we route for 30-day deferred payment — which finance can make an exception for but prefers to avoid.

Next steps: if you confirm option (1) + (2) we will:
- Send the addendum (PDF) and the credit voucher (PDF) for e-signature.
- Apply the credit to your evaluation project once the addendum is executed.

I've attached the addendum draft (POC_Addendum_v1.pdf) to this email for review.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: POC_Addendum_v1.pdf

From: Claire O'Neill <claire@brightbytelabs.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot addendum & onboarding credit — BrightByte Labs

Hi Laura — thanks, that sounds good. We'll take option (1) + (2). Two small clarifications:

- Can the onboarding credit be applied immediately (so the team can run the surge this afternoon)?
- We prefer e-sign via DocuSign; please send the link.

If you can get the credit applied now and the DocuSign link over, we'll sign and complete procurement next week. Appreciate the flexibility.

Claire
